WITH OrderTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_id,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS order_total
    FROM Orders o
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status_code = 'Delivered'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    AVG(order_total) AS average_order_value
FROM OrderTotals ot
JOIN Customers c ON ot.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS order_value
    FROM Orders o
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status_code IN ('Delivered', 'Cancelled')
        AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.date_order_placed) = strftime('%Y-%m', datetime('now', '-1 month'))
    GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT 
    ot.customer_id,
    COUNT(ot.order_id) AS order_count,
    ROUND(AVG(ot.order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM order_totals ot
GROUP BY ot.customer_id
